analysis.narrativeEn:

· RSI trajectory (47.3 → 35.2): Diagnosing entry into oversold territory, indicating continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.2596 → -3.3280): Diagnosing bearish expansion, reinforcing the downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $344.75) + Bandwidth at 26.30% indicating a period of expanding volatility.

· Swing resistance ($380.00): First resistance level for any short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day price pattern (Higher Low): Confirming support at lower levels, suggesting potential for a rebound.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.88x): Subdued volume, lowering confidence in trend reversal.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): While RSI entering oversold and Higher Low confirmation suggest potential for buying, MACD deterioration and subdued volume warrant maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
